_doc: CAS-167: the 5 playable class heroes are now derived DIRECTLY from the canonical Main Character (art-reference/main-character.png — the Drive sprite). STYLE FORMULA law: same hooded silhouette, proportion, pixel density for ALL classes; only the cloak HUE + sash ACCENT shift within the family. Replaces the earlier off-style redesigns (full-plate warrior, pointy-hat mage) the CEO rejected. Each <cls>.png is a 6-frame breathing-idle strip and <cls>_walk.png an 8-frame walk-cycle (alt-leg swing+lift + body footfall bob) — no static characters. Built by tools/cas167-build-classes.mjs. render.js loads <cls>.png as clshero_* and <cls>_walk.png as clswalk_*; cell geom unchanged so CLASS_ANIM_SCALE stays 0.32.
protected: hood-interior / outline / legs kept near-black across all classes so the family reads as one character
